full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white photographic close-up shows a face filling almost the entire frame against a nearly black background. The head turns slightly to the left and tilts upward, so the nose and mouth project toward the left edge while the lit cheek and chin occupy the lower center. The crop cuts across the hair at the top and along the neck and jaw at the bottom; there is no clothing or setting to identify. Short dark hair falls in loose strands across the forehead. One eye is partially visible high on the left side, looking out from between a bright sliver of brow and the broad darkness across the upper face. The bridge of the nose and the lower lip catch hard pale light, while a dense black diagonal shadow passes over the other eye and most of the cheek. A second bright patch shapes the side of the nose, and the rounded chin holds a cooler gray highlight. The lips are closed and relaxed. Light reveals fine skin grain and tiny speckles on the illuminated planes, then ends abruptly at the shadow boundary. The shadow is deep enough to erase some facial contour without flattening the lit features; the outer right side of the head merges with the dark ground. The camera is very close and low relative to the face, making the features monumental and turning the play of light into the main structure of the image. Contrast is high but not purely graphic: silver midtones give the skin volume, and faint texture remains inside some darker passages. The photograph has a tactile, slightly grainy surface and a still, introspective feeling. Its composition is held by the strong diagonal division between luminous facial planes and a large mass of black, with no distracting surrounding detail.
full_prompt_zh: 一张方形黑白摄影特写让面容几乎填满全幅，背景近乎全黑。头略向左转并微微仰起，因此鼻子与嘴朝左边伸出，受光的脸颊和下巴位于下方中央。画面在上端切过头发，在下端沿脖颈与下颌裁去；没有衣着或场景可供辨认。短暗发丝松散垂在额前。一只眼在左上方局部可见，从眉上的细亮边与盖住上半张脸的大片黑暗之间望出。鼻梁与下唇接住坚硬浅光，一道浓黑斜影则穿过另一只眼和大半脸颊。第二处亮斑塑出鼻侧，圆润下巴带着更冷的灰色高光。双唇闭合而放松。光揭示亮面上的细微皮肤颗粒与小斑点，然后在明暗交界处骤然停止。阴影深到抹去部分脸部轮廓，却没有压平受光五官；头部右外沿融入暗背景。相机离脸很近，视点相对偏低，使五官显得巨大，也让光的变化成为画面主要结构。反差很高却并非纯图形化：银灰中间调给予皮肤体积，部分暗部里仍有微弱纹理。照片表面可触般略有颗粒，气息静止而内省。构图由发亮的面部平面与大片黑色之间强烈的斜向分割支撑，周围没有分散注意的细节。
style_prompt_en: Black-and-white photography compresses the setting into deep, almost seamless darkness and lets a few hard illuminated planes carry the form. Sharp diagonal shadow boundaries cut across softer curved transitions, while silver midtones preserve volume and fine grain within the brighter passages. Highlights are narrow and concentrated rather than evenly spread; much of the frame remains a dense, quiet black. Close cropping removes contextual space and magnifies small textural changes, giving the tonal divisions a monumental scale. The darkest edges merge with the background, while isolated pale contours separate only where directional light reaches them. This balance of abrupt contrast, tactile gray detail, and generous negative space produces a still, sculptural image.
style_prompt_zh: 黑白摄影把环境压成深沉、几乎无缝的暗处，让少量受硬光照亮的平面承载形体。锐利斜向影界切过较柔和的弯曲过渡，银灰中间调在较亮的区域里保留体积与细颗粒。高光狭窄而集中，并不均匀铺开；画面大部仍是浓厚安静的黑色。近距离裁切移走语境空间，放大细小肌理变化，使明暗分割拥有巨大的尺度。最暗边缘与背景融在一起，孤立浅色轮廓只在定向光照到之处才分开。突兀反差、可触的灰调细节与宽大留白之间的平衡，形成静止而有雕塑感的画面。
theme_en: A close-up face half lost in dramatic black shadow
theme_zh: 一张近景面容有半边隐入强烈黑影
name: Lucien Clergue
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
